project_title: Ocean Freight Shipment Tracker Dashboard - Internal Freight Forwarder Tool
archetype: Maritime Precision & High-Density Logistics Operations (Swiss Utility x Technical Command Center)

theme.primary_concept: Deep Ocean Obsidian slate backdrop, Signal Teal/Cyan status indicators, Cargo Amber alerts, Crisp Zinc/White high-contrast grid lines, and Industrial Monospace data typography.
forbidden_colors: pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or overlays

typography.font_family_heading: JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Space Mono, monospace
typography.font_family_data: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Courier New, monospace

hierarchy.table_header: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/90
hierarchy.doc_number_code: font-mono text-xs font-semibold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30
hierarchy.status_badge: text-xs font-mono font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full inline-flex items-center gap-1.5

spacing_and_layout.mode: High Density Grid & Spreadsheet Mode B
spacing_and_layout.density_rules: Compact 32px-36px table row height, tight gap-3/gap-4 in dashboard widgets, 100% horizontal stretch for tables with sticky column headers and sticky first columns for Shipper/Consignee and Vessel.

grid_structure.kpi_bar: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3 mb-6

global_dashboard.summary: High-level overview displaying total active FCL & LCL shipments, total clients, pending ANFs, delayed vessels, upcoming ETDs (next 7 days), and carrier distribution breakdown chart.

client_management.summary: Manage tracking profiles per client, customize optional table columns per client, and view status history.

spreadsheet_shipment_table.summary: Data-dense interactive table where comments can be edited inline or via quick status preset chips.
spreadsheet_shipment_table.stacked_vessel_column: Displays Vessel Name in bold top line (e.g., 'MSC MAYA 412E') and tracking doc number below in mono badge font (e.g., 'MEDU12345678') with quick copy button.
spreadsheet_shipment_table.track_trace_link: Deep-link button on every row pointing to track-trace.com/container or bill of lading tracking.
spreadsheet_shipment_table.anf_received_workflow: Marking 'ANF received. Docs to Ops.' sets ANF flag, highlights row in purple, and excludes shipment from the generated daily client report.

daily_status_report_generator.summary: Generates a clean daily client status report PDF & Excel export containing only active shipments where ANF has NOT been archived.

data_testid_convention.rule: Every interactive button, input, toggle, table row, select, and modal trigger MUST have a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-tenant ocean freight cargo tracker dashboard with Client Management, Shipment Tracking Table, Daily Status Report Generator, and Analytics.
Ensure the Vessel column displays the Vessel Name on top and the Tracking Document Number stacked directly below in a styled code block.
Provide quick preset comment buttons above/inside the comment field ('Planned ETD 05.09.', 'Vessel delayed slightly. Now planned ETD 09.09.', 'Shipped on board', 'ANF received. Docs to Ops.').
Implement column customization toggles per client (e.g. toggle on/off 'H/bill released by supplier', 'Expected ocean freight rate'). Save client toggles in localStorage or backend.
When a shipment is marked with 'ANF received. Docs to Ops.', archive/exclude it from the next generated client daily report while keeping it visible in the main history filter.
Ensure 'Track on track-trace.com' quick links open external tracking in a new tab with the doc number parameter (e.g. https://www.track-trace.com/container?number=MEDU1234567).
Use Lucide React icons for port/vessel/container/file-export/settings icons.
Ensure exact data-testid attributes are present on all interactive components.
